def snap(fr):
    out=[]
    for n in fr.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c') and 10<n['pixels']<200 and n['boundary'][0][0]>5:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'],min(rows),min(cols),max(rows),max(cols)))
    return out
for i in range(7):
    action(['DOWN'])
    s=snap(current_frame)
    print("DOWN",i+1,s, "done:",last_action_result.get('done'),"lvl:",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): break
